motion.name: endpoint-inspection
motion.value: 55ms pointer damping; 65ms fade damping; 700ms acquisition sweep; 550ms maximum press pulse; 0.78 alpha cap
motion.purpose: Segmented inspection rings render only in the reserved external-link endpoint on eligible hover. They settle after acquisition; an inline SVG provides static feedback for focus, touch, reduced preferences, or unavailable WebGL2.

components.css: .sample-group { display: inline-flex; padding: 2px; background: #142332; } .sample { position: relative; min-width: 44px; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 .625rem; border: 0; border-radius: 0; background: #0b121b; color: #8bdcff; font: 400 .6875rem/1.6 "JetBrains Mono", ui-monospace, monospace; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 180ms cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1); } .sample::before, .sample::after { position: absolute; content: ""; width: 7px; height: 7px; pointer-events: none; } .sample::before { inset: 0 auto auto 0; border-top: 1px solid #8bdcff; border-left: 1px solid #8bdcff; } .sample::after { inset: auto 0 0 auto; border-bottom: 1px solid #8bdcff; border-right: 1px solid #8bdcff; } .sample:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #8bdcff; outline-offset: 4px; } .sample:active { transform: translateY(1px); transition-duration: 80ms; } @media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce) { .sample { transition: none; transform: none; } }

narrative.overview: Visible navigation, a plain-text identity, unnumbered content, and real project destinations stay central. A soft header backdrop, endpoint inspection, smooth row feedback, and a short theme crossfade add depth. Wide screens use sticky section labels, a week strip, two-column Stack and Social layouts, and two music columns.
keyCharacteristics: Endpoint inspection appears only during eligible pointer interaction

researchInterpretation.summary: The endpoint inspection is an original interpretation of localized information density and bounded acquisition displays. It does not reproduce franchise art, characters, symbols, or text.

rules.name: Content and access
rules.body: Keep original content and destinations. Preserve keyboard focus, no-script access, and reduced-motion behavior.

dos: Use semantic colors and shared controls.
donts: Do not hide written content on small screens.
